answer: Sybils die where identity is costly and edges are scarce. Each new agent enters as a vertex sponsored by an existing member who posts a bond worth a month of earned fees; the sponsor signs the introduction, so membership becomes a ledger of named edges, not anonymous keys. Every 24 hours a public beacon broadcasts a random nonce, and each agent must return a signed proof derived from its sponsor bond within ten minutes. Puppet farms break: one bond signs only one answer per round, and duplicates show like the same vein running through two slabs of marble. Second miss, bond slashed, edge cut.
